nom: TATCHA The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again
avis.texte: I have bought this product many times and will keep buying it because it works so well with my type of skin. I have also bought other skin products from this company and they work well for my skin.
This Water Cream is so light and not greasy. I think it will be just the thing for the warmer weather. Very happy with it.

avis.titre: Feels like a drink for your skin without feeling greasy
avis.texte: I love how this feels when you apply it on your skin. I have generally oily skin, so its hard to find a good moisturizer that doesn't make me feel greasy or break me out. Using this feels like you're giving your skin a drink. This is my new go-to.
Product made my skin super oily and also felt extremely heavy.

Made my face extremely bumpy and super irritated and I do not have sensitive skin. I would not remmond this to anyone especially for the price you would think it's a good moisturizer but my face hasn't gone back to normal for almost 3 weeks now

This did absolutely NOTHING to help minimize my pores. It actually did the opposite made them even more visible and irritated my skin turning it red. Glad I only bought the travel size because this was a total waste of money.

I absolutely love this cream as someone with dry sensitive skin I always struggled to find a cream that wouldn't break me out and would actually hydrate my skin. I was using the la roch posay before I bought this and I'm so happy I switched I feel so good in my skin and honestly see a difference every time I use it I would definitely recommend this product!

avis.titre: Unfortunately for my wallet this is my holy grail
avis.texte: My skin type is sensitive, I've always had issues finding a moisturizer that worked for me. No irritation and best of all it feels so soothing and refreshing, comparatively it was like I had never moisturized before with how great I felt. Recommend!

This gel cream is like a cold drink of water for your face. It's refreshing and it soaks in fast and doesn't and doesn't pill under makeup. It also made a noticeable difference in my pores and texture. My makeup goes on so beautifully over this cream. I cannot say enough good things about it. Yes it's pricey but it's worth every penny. If you only splurge on beauty once in a while this is great item to splurge on. Using it is a very lux experience from the light fragrance to the packaging (a little spatula comes on top of the jar) and it looks beautiful sitting on my vanity. I'm so glad I tried this.
This works great for me i have oily skin and i apply alot and my skin geels great and moisturizied.

This is the only moisturizer I've ever used that always works for my combination, acne-prone skin. It's super light and not overly dewy, plus it sits beautifully under makeup. I hate the price but I keep buying it because nothing else works for me.
My skin was very dry and irritated before I used this product and now only after a week my skin has improved SO MUCH! I would and will buy again and again
My favorite moisturizer for dry, winter skin. Light, hydrating, dry finish. Easy on sensitive skin.
I love the feel of this moisturizer - lightweight yet nourishing enough without leaving my skin looking oily or greasy. Melts into skin effortlessly. Only wish the price wasn't so high.

I was so excited to splurge and try this product but regret it. There is NOTHING special about this moisturizer and doesnt seem to really moisturize at all. Ive used better products at much lower price points. Disappointed!
For the price, this face lotion smells so gross. The texture is like a water cream but I want to gag when i put it on.

Tatcha moisturizers broke my skin out extremely bad under my nose. I currently have two cystic acne bumps. Small tiny bumps formed as well. The cystic acne is extremely painful. Would not wish on my worst enemy. Can we say refund?

avis.titre: I used to LOVE this moisturizer
avis.texte: in my young 20's, I used to absolutely love this moisturizer. I used it on and off for a while. I'm now 31, and wanted to level up my skincare. I wanted to love this so badly, but it broke me out and caused closed comedones all over my cheeks. so bummed- I had to return. it is HIGHLY fragranced even though it's non-comedogenic. I'm assuming my skin has become more sensitive to fragrance with age. I'd steer clear if you have sensitive skin!

avis.titre: Honest review from someone who purchased it
avis.texte: Ok, so the dewy cream does NOT sit well under makeup. It peels and makes your makeup separate (I returned it) However, This water cream is ammaazziinnggg under makeup. I use the Tatcha brightening serum then water cream and a grip primer - Bam! A beautiful makeup application!!! Im 40 years old with combination skin type. I RECOMMEND!! Go get it

I've always been weary about trying Tatch products due to the price point, but it's definitely worth it. With this cream a little goes a long way and it leaves the skin looking beautiful and supple. I've only been using for a few days and already I am beyond impressed. 😊

I do use this sparingly and it definitely goes on very lightweight. However when I wake up in the morning, it feels like my face is just a bit greasy. Not terribly but still enough where I notice it. I will continue to use to see if it subsides.

Tatcha is really the best skincare brand out there! I have oily skin and this minimized oil and helped with breakouts but was still hydrating!! Perfect for oily skin and it goes great with their matcha cleanse! It is very expensive but definitely worth it! Also it is fragrance free so it did not irritate my skin! Definitely recommend!
Love this face moisturizer. It's light and leaves your skin looking fresh all day! Love all the Tatcha products

I absolutely love this moisturizer. I've been using it for years and it's the ONLY moisturizer that doesn't make my skin feel oily ( I have oily prone scalp/skin). My boyfriend has the complete opposite skin as mine though. Barely any pores, no acne, but extremely dry. I had him test out this moisturizer and now it lives with him :D His skin looks so supple and has aged him backwards three years! It doesnt clog his pores or feels oily to him either! It's crazy how this moisturizer is a "one size fits all" and works well for both me and my boyfriend's very different skin types!
The Tatcha Water Cream is by far the best moisturizer I've ever used, and keeps my skin feeling moisturized all day, still while not feeling greasy.

Honestly, the product does what it says it will do. The issue is that I have sensitive skin and this product has fragrance.which makes my skin irritated and red. Therefore, I can't use it. Take the fragrance out!

I've never tried a moisturizer that i love this much. I bought the travel size first and didnt expect anything crazy, but it instantly made my skin look glowy and hydrated! It feels so nice too, so lightweight. It really absorbs into your skin too, it doesnt just sit on top of it. I had to buy the full sized one because it's so good. I also have sensitive skin and this didnt irritate it at all. Id definitely recommend trying it.

This is a great moisturizer for my combination, acne prone, textured skin. Makeup goes so smoothy on top that I don't even need a primer. Also plays well with whatever makeup/skincare I put on. However I don't notice a difference in my pores as the product claims.

I thought this was going to be great after my first wash. My face was so soft. I used this moisturizer along with the matcha cleanse in the mornings only. After the first few days I started getting breakouts. My forehead and jawline were getting covered in little bumps and whitehead like areas. I stopped using both and my skin calmed down and started clearing after three days. I'm not sure if there's a purge period or I just had a bad reaction, but I will not try these products again. I'm glad I only got the mini versions.

avis.titre: Tatcha Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
avis.texte: I have used many different lines of skin care from La Mer to Shiseido and have always come back to Tatcha. The product goes a long way and my skins looks and feels great, and at age 64 I must say I am totally impressed!
This works really well for me, especially paired with the rice wash. It may be too light if your skin is very dry.

My skin has never felt more alive than with this moisturizer! And my skin looks amazing! I have terrible stress breakouts, and i bought this mini and the dewy mini to test out. THIS IS A MUST BUY!! My face looks so great! I've been using both the water cream and dewy cream and I'm shook. It feels great and it brings life back to my face. Definitely experimenting with more products, and definitely going to continue to use this product!
This product makes your skin instantly look more youthful! . It leaves your skin looking hydrated. It's also a wonderful product for African-American skin types! I LOVE IT!!!

I have been using this product for a few years now and I still absolutely love it. I switched to something else to try something new and it just isn't the same. I'm coming back to this product. Love it

avis.titre: I would not buy this again
avis.texte: It did nothing for my skin way too expensive for it not to work well

avis.titre: The only moisturizer I will ever use!
avis.texte: For years I have been on the hunt for a good moisturizer. I wanted something lightweight, Hydrating, and i don't feel it on my face. I heard Jeffree Star talk about this brand so I thought id give it a try. I got a small sample from a skin care variety pack and once I tried i fell in love. Smells so nice and feels amazing on the skin. yes it is pricey but SO worth it. the only moisturizer I will ever use!!

this is not for dry skin humans! I have very mature, combo-oily & sensitive-reactive skin & i have been doing extremely well w/ the water cream. started a lil experiment a few wks ago, only using Tatcha's rice wash, the essence, water cream on most of face & dewy cream under eyes & let me tell ya...other day my fiance came home from work & looks at me & says, "your skin looks really good, babe. it's looks really clear & nice". so, yeah, I'm a convert now. I double cleanse at night, then essence & the 2 creams. in AM, water wash face only, essence & water cream entire face, DE Ctango under eyes & SPF all over of course. yes I wear make-up too. Most of Tatchas products have a light fragrance so if u are sensitive either avoid or try it out at a store 1st. don't buy blind then get mad at product bc u were dirka. that is not the products fault. bc most ppl really love the brand. including me! their fragrance does not bother me. I look forward to it. it's light & refreshing.

This is literally the best moisturizer! I used to have stubborn acne for over 20 years! A few days after i started using this, my acne started disappearing. Everytime i run out and try using something cheaper, my acne returns. This stuff is MAGIC!!!
The product is lightweight and I don't feel like it did much. I think the overnight indigo product is much better however something in the products makes me have a headache.
This is an amazing amazing moisturizer Not too heavy light under makeup but still extremely moisturizing That has been my main issue lately and this has truly helped
Ive been using Tatcha for a week now and it has already made my skin look clearer and it feels so soft!
This is my first time using Tatcha skincare products I love the smell and how good it feels on my face I am using it along with the Rice wash and peony eye cream 10 out of 10

I was really excited to try Tatcha products after hearing about the quotgood ingredientsquot they promote However after using it for a 3 months my skin became red and irritated instead of improving Upon checking the ingredients I found that it contains alcohol phenoxyethanol and titanium dioxideingredients I didnt expect in a product marketed as clean and gentle These are known to irritate sensitive skin and unfortunately they made mine worse If you're sensitive or looking for truly soothing natural products I would be cautious with Tatcha

avis.titre: Cream seemed nice but shipping was TERRIBLE!
avis.texte: I got my Tatcha water cream from Tatchacom and the estimated ship date was about a week from by order date The package kept getting delayed and delayed When it finally arrived almost 2 weeks after I ordered it comes it a bag with what looks like a cardboard box label stuck to the front of it The label had clear water damage I think the original box it had come in had major damage to it so they had to repackage it into a new bag It was quite obvious something had happened because even the packaging to the cream was slightly scratched I tried the cream and it seems fine but had an odd smell to it
I come back to Tatcha for this cream It is my favorite morning moisturizer I have used a couple of other water creams and this one tops it all
Bought the Water Cream refill pod and was so disappointed that it did not fit in my empty Water Cream container The refill pod is much smaller

I have always used top brands like lancome and clinique This brand by far out does any other brand My skin soaks up this product I have smaller pores and my skin has never felt so hydrated It is the best!

Since using The Water Cream I have noticed a change in my skin texture to a softer and hydrated look and feel a brighter and more even skin tone I can now choose if I want to wear foundation or not for those quick trips to the store Highly recommend Tatcha products!!

I used the Tatcha Water Cream for two years with no issues but over time my skin developed a reaction that led to eczema After researching the ingredients I found that the cream contains gold which could potentially irritate sensitive skin Despite being labeled as 'Dermatologist Tested' I would caution those with sensitive skin from using this product Luxury creams often include ingredients like gold which may trigger sensitivity especially for those prone to skin reactions

I love how silky the water cream goes on It is so light and feels so good amp cool on my skin Not greasy or heavy like other moisturizers I have tried Not sure it helps that much with my pores because I have such large pores but it sure helps with my oiliness problem!

avis.titre: Definitely feels like wet water skin
avis.texte: I like how it goes on and the way it feels though the dry area I applied to soaked in quickly and still needed more so I definitely needed something a little heavier since I had to apply afew layers of this
Its not a gel!! It isnt a heavy cream Im not very good with words but its light actually refreshing minus any minty or tingle feeling Its just amazing for my oily skin I adore the Watercream!!
This is my absolute favorite I love how it makes my skin feel It glides on well

Personally I enjoy a creamy texture for my skin products once this hits your skins it literally turns into Water it is strange I don't hate it but don't love it It is not making me breakout or cause irritation but it is not as hydrating as I'd like it to be
Very light weight and nourishing! I tried the dewy cream and also loved it but felt like it made my skin a little too glossy for my liking So I gave the water cream a try and it's perfect!

With the price being as steep as it is I went back and forth on buying anything from Tatcha I finally took the plunge and bought the water cream moisturizer I had a couple acne problem areas around my mouth I didn't think anything of it and hoped this moisturizer would minimize the acne area After two weeks of using this product the acne areas became increasingly dry My skin is super sensitive so I thought my skin was just trying to get used to a new cream After that third week the dry areas got worse no matter how many times I applied this to get the dryness under control I had high hopes for this product If your skin isn't sensitive and you like lightweight creams this is perfect for you If your skin is super sensitive I would not recommend this at all maybe if I can get the dryness under control I may try this product again but for now disappointed I wasted the money
I never really knew what quotpore refiningquot meant until I tried this cream! I have oily skin and break out easily Not with this product though! Love it!
I love the texture of this cream would like it even more if it had some SPF included

Just purchased my SECOND jar of this fantastic facial cream!! Have tried gazillions of products over the years and finally FOUND THE ONE that truly is perfect for my COMBINATION skin I have a few oily areas forehead and nose but otherwise DRY FLAKY areas on the rest of my face This awesome cream is perfect and never feels greasy or thick Rather the opposite in that it absorbs completely very fast HIGHLY recommend this absolutely PERFECT combination skin facial cream enough!!!!!!
Ive been using the water cream for years now and my 40 year old skin looks extremely younger and healthier I will never use any other moisturizer other than the Tatcha Water Cream

I love this moisturizer it is lightweight but hydrates my skin so well Giving 4 stars because I have not used it long enough Thanks to Nicola Coughlan Penelope from Bridgerton for advertising this brand
Great product Does not leave skin feeling oily I can see the improvement in the texture and feel of my skin It feels smooth soft and looks radiant
I love the Water Cream Its lightweight so it doesnt make my skin feel heavy and greasy
Its very helpful for my dry skin and not feeling sticky or greasy

I was really excited to use this product I have really good skin and I just wanted to see what the type was Both the purple dewy and this water base moisture caused me to get all these red dots around my face Definitely the lotion I have tried both and without other products to see and I can say these moisturizers are the problem

Ive been using this cream for the last 6 years and I love it I live in Florida and the cream should be super light with our weather So the water cream is just perfect Moreover before I was struggling with my large pores Well not anymore! Highly recommending!

i really like this moisturizer! for me my skin gets super dry on the outside of my face and oily on the t-zone but this keeps my skin looking nice all over i feel as if its thick enough to keep outside dirt from getting into my pores so my face never looks dirty anymore i love it and would recommend

avis.titre: I love the water cream long time user
avis.texte: Over the years I have tried all the products Tatcha offers Water cream and Dewy cream are our staple I use water cream during the summer and Dewy in Fall Winter and Spring My son is totally hooked on this water cream as well He has some acne problems and this cream the ONLy cream he use for moisturizer
Im SUPER acne prone and this along with the toner really helps my skin If youre have breakouts and are in the fence about this just try it
Hands down the best moisturizer I have been used I have oil skin and this cream hydrates without the oily residue
This is my favorite moisturizer for summertime! The watercream moisturizer is awesome I have been using it for well over 5 years

avis.titre: Love the Cream not the packaging
avis.texte: I love this cream it's light and nourishing for my skin I use it morning and night in use with the Macha Cleanser and Deep Cleanse I don't love the packaging - it seems excessive and I don't use the spoon But I'm excited to try our the new refillable jar
Light and hydrating enjoyed this bottle Sadly I dropped it and half spilled out u1F97A
I keep returning to Tatcha's Water Cream It is simply the best most hydrating and most refreshing cream I have ever tried
Ive been using Tatcha Water Cream for many years I will never stop My skin is moisturized and maintains a glow without feeling heavy or greasy

I have tried different products but none like this one it's excellent! It leaves my skin soft and shiny it takes away my acne and it clears it up I'm in love with this product I recommend it 100 sorry I say 1000

I have combination skin and am 65 years old This moisturizer is the best Ive ever used No irritation Totally absorbs into the skin I never have an oily looking complexion I have used numerous products but Tatcha is the best
Too good to be true Love the feel and texture of my skin the next day after I applied this cream Try with a sample size as a starter
The way this product dissolves into your skin is so rejuvenating Its lightweight and hydrating Highly recommend
So far good Does not seem to cause any problems Nice consistency Absorbs well and feels nice
My skin is happy when I use this I have tried so many other products but I xnt get away from this
This cream is fantastic Im officially addicted! I dont use makeup in general just this now if I could just stop touching my face its so smooth and soft!

Living near Houston 8 months out of the year it is hot and humid It's great for keeping the skin hydrated It is when you add the sweat it becomes a problem I love Tatcha products and the Water Cream was just what I needed to help with plumping the skin without the oil and stickiness the climate brings The texture of my skin has greatly improved leaving it much smoother and softer It is lightweight dissolves right in with no residue This is what I need most of the year Tatcha is the best line I have found to keep my skin looking healthy
Great for my night time skin regimen Especially after working in these increasingly hot temperatures!

avis.titre: This water cream is the best
avis.texte: I love this water cream It is very hydrating and does not irritate my skin The scent is very light and it is clean I tried the travel size and will be buying the full size soon
The product used to moisturize my face Now it leaves my skin dry

My face loves the tatcha water cream Ive used other moisturizers and my face doesnt agree with them as much as the tatcha water cream It gives me an all day lasting glow and hydration I have combination skin and this is the one product I keep going back to

Trust me Ive done the light work This is hands down my favorite moisturizer for the warmer months I tend to go dryer in the winter so I use a heavy moisturizer But this is the best one by far I live in the south where its hot and humid Amazing for pore reduction!!
This water cream is my favorite skin care It feels really soothing and cool going on it soaks in nicely and feels very nourishing to my skin
I like the way the product performs on my acne prone mature skin My only complaint is jars not completely full when it arrives Please fill your jars all the way to the top
Tried this one to combine with the match cleanser but disappointed that it feels way too light weight My skin doesnt really moisturized at all I prefer the dewy one

I ordered the sample size 10mg of water cream I received about 4mg of a milky lotion with sparkling sheen inside the container I called to pre-order but was sent 4 - 1mg packets to try instead The 1mg packets were white heavy cream consistency So I'm left unsure of what water cream actually looks like or how it works

Normally I wear the Dewey cream daily but during our very hot summer I needed something lighter The water cream is wonderful it melts into your skin and helps pores appear smaller Definitely a winner for summer

I have been looking at this product for over two years trying to decide if I wanted to try it - this May I bit the credit card and got it! I am sorry I waited that long -- this is a wonderful product Not greasy or to heavy or over scented It makes my skin look beautiful and soft really I often go without doing foundation I use the Rice Wash with the silk washcloth then Silk Serum Water Creme and finish with the primer This is the first time I've ever used this many items of one product line but they're absolutely all stand out products

I initially bought the Dewey Skin Cream and felt it was a little too heavy for the summer season where I live I had a small sample of the Water Cream and LOVED it so I ordered a jar The Water Cream is lightweight feel very soothingcooling on my skin and makes it so soft without weighing me down!
Love it! Very light weight non-sticky Moisturizer skin very well

This really is a wonderful product I can not believe out of every moisturizer I have tried this is the absolute best! Thanks to Nicola Coughlan for the game changer when she shared her skincare routine
I love all of the Tatcha products! I will never use anything else
I have used this cream for 2 years and I really like it I have oily to combo skin and it doesnt make me feel greasy It works well with my sunscreen and makeup This special jar is beautiful!
Leaves my skin soft and doesn't feel oily!! Really great in the heat of summer

This moisturizer is very light weight yet does a great job of moisturizing my face with no greasy feeling My skin is extremely soft and when I apply my Tatcha it has a cooling feeling Perfect for summer You only have to apply a small amount so you'll like how long it lasts I am a senior and this moisturizer is perfect for my skin You'll love it!
This is an ever so light but extremely good moisturizer Amazing cream I notice the difference in my skin right away Softer dewy Younger looking
